result.topic_en: Calculations toward the asymptotic distribution of zeta zeros: summing log(1+tt/αα) over roots α via Euler–Maclaurin with a counting function λ(x), evaluating beta-type integrals, deriving an asymptotic formula for λ(x), and setting up a saddle-point (Riemann–Siegel type) evaluation of ∫ e^{-nnπx} x^{s/2-1} dx.
